data.title: 三司绫濑 · 聚光灯亮起
data.description: 灯光落下时，绫濑走到舞台中央，朝观众席挥手。她把紧张藏在动作里，站稳后才露出笑容。
data.action: standing under a spotlight and waving toward the audience
data.promptProse: In the center of a vast, darkened stage, Ayase is brilliantly illuminated by a sharp, intense white spotlight, her glossy performance costume sparkling vividly under the directed beam. She stands with poised elegance, waving gracefully toward the obscured, cheering audience, while the dramatic radial light patterns on the polished wooden stage floor and the subtle haze of stage smoke amplify the iconic stage atmosphere.
